void vOliEngine::assignToVariable(const std::wstring& varExpr, const vData& newValue) {
---
std::wstring trimmedExpr = trim(varExpr);
---
size_t firstSep = trimmedExpr.find_first_of(L"[.");
---
// 1. Identificam radacina ?i daca se for?eaza contextul global (@)
---
std::wstring fullRoot = (firstSep == std::wstring::npos) ? trimmedExpr : trimmedExpr.substr(0, firstSep);
---
bool forceGlobal = (!fullRoot.empty() && fullRoot[0] == L'@');
---
std::wstring varName = fullRoot;
---
// 2. LOGICA DE REFLEXIE (Dereferen?iere pointeri)
---
size_t dollarPos = varName.find(L'$');
---
unset all
---
def struct Pozitie {x, y}
---
def struct Entitate {nume, poz}
---
set $erou = Entitate("Galahad", Pozitie(10, 10))
---
set $boss = Entitate("Dragon", Pozitie(500, 500))
---
echo "Pozitie initiala Erou: " + $erou.poz.x + "," + $erou.poz.y
---
echo "Pozitie initiala Boss: " + $boss.poz.x + "," + $boss.poz.y
---
echo ""
---
TELEPORT_DINAMIC("erou", 25, 25)
---
TELEPORT_DINAMIC("boss", 999, 999)
---
echo ""
---
